title: ThreatAdaptation
description: The Static's Threat Director adapted its defense to what it suffered, or announces what its operations are doing (CONTRACTS §6; THREAT-DIRECTOR §4 step 5, C37; NX-156). `UP` when the matching operation launched (escorts appear, air defense is reinforced), `DOWN` when its threat-memory counter has decayed away again. Sector level only: it names no site and updates no facility marker (Q-FOW-17, FOG-OF-WAR FOW-13). Two categories also name a node (nodes are public, FOW-10). HOLD_AT_RISK (NX-412 part 4, ECONOMY EC-9, Q-TD-19): a capture operation was launched on a node of the coalition's running victory hold, always UP, no DOWN. STRIKE_DOWNED (NX-431, Q-TD-56): viewer units took out the last jet of a Static strike package; node_id is the struck node, always UP. SANCTUARY_AT_RISK (NX-493, Q-TD-122): the coalition sanctuary's defense hp fell from full, node_id the sanctuary, always UP. Public view: this INTEL line.

side.description: The side whose Director adapted (only the ENEMY's runs until NX-375).

category.description: CONVOY_ESCORT: escorts for convoys after `convoy_attacks`. IADS_REINFORCED: air defense reinforced after `radar_strikes`. HOLD_AT_RISK: a capture operation (OFFENSIVE, RETAKE) launched on a node of the running victory hold, the sitrep "NULL moves on <node>, the hold is at risk" (Q-TD-19). STAGING: a capture operation started forward staging at a base in the sector (THREAT-DIRECTOR §4a FS-5, NX-416), the sitrep "NULL forces are massing in <sector>", always UP, sector level only (no node_id, FOW-13). STAGING_LAUNCHED and STAGING_DISPERSED (NX-431, Q-TD-47) close a STAGING sitrep, once, in the sector it named: the staged operation launched from its staging base, the sitrep "NULL assault launching from <sector>"; or the massing ended otherwise (dropped, timed out or fell back to the rear, or re-staged where the coalition sees nothing or in another sector), the sitrep "massing disperses" (Q-TD-47 wording) for sector_id; always UP, no node_id. STRIKE_DOWNED (NX-431, Q-TD-56): a viewer unit's hit destroyed, disabled or mission-killed the last unit of a Static STRIKE job still in the fight, the sitrep "NULL strike package downed near <node>" crediting credit_ids, once per job, on that tick; always UP, node_id the job's target node and sector_id its sector. SANCTUARY_AT_RISK (NX-493, Q-TD-122): a hit took the coalition sanctuary's defense hp below full, the sitrep "NULL strikes <node>, the sanctuary is at risk" (its board posts the defend job at the top urgency, GAMEPLAY §1b); once per drop from full (a repair to full and a new hit give another), always UP, node_id the sanctuary and sector_id its sector.

node_id.description: HOLD_AT_RISK: the hold node the operation targets; STRIKE_DOWNED: the struck node; SANCTUARY_AT_RISK: the coalition sanctuary; null for every other category.

credit_ids.description: STRIKE_DOWNED: the viewer (COMMANDER-owned) units whose hit destroyed, disabled or mission-killed a unit holding the STRIKE job, ascending, no duplicates (producer; not uniqueItems, SC-14), the 32 lowest ids; empty for every other category (always sent).
